beneficiary: The same confirmed traveler choosing whether and where to stop for one actual field specimen during the existing component-to-Crossing journey.
question: Can one finite original sample case create a visible site/timing/custody choice that pays the actual existing encounter beat and announced threat, without changing child rules or fabricating cargo, survival, XP, completion or return?

selection.selected: Original finite sampling in existing FieldJourney; no new wrapper or gameplay engine.
alternatives: Finite health/resolve aid is consequential but requires authoritative Session changes and broad prior binding revalidation; historical magnitudes are blank.
Authorable preparation cards provide production value but mainly expose existing decisions, not a comparable new exploration consequence.
Licensed Unity/ordinary-user/player/device access remains valuable but no verified current access establishes feasibility.
selection.disagreement: Science/Creation initially preferred finite aid; Engineering preferred cards. Primary chose the separately proposed lower-dependency sampling action because it delegates actual Wait and owns only new sample custody. Other alternatives remain credible.

setup.source: Explicit original experiment setup, not purchased/acquired historical item or a source catalogue integration.
setup.site_identity: Original local observations, no historical lore, resource reward or approved canon.

authority.owners: Existing FieldJourney Room coordinates unchanged private Intake/Memory/Forge/Loadout/Crossing; only Sampling owns case and specimen custody.
authority.sample: Known exact site, current active stage and exact position plus unused case; sample delegates one actual existing Wait. Only accepted Wait consumes case. Its original damage/beat/terminal/reward result is authoritative.
authority.acquisition: Only after accepted Wait with HP>0 and surviving active/won/complete state; fatal or failed sample consumes case without acquisition.
authority.custody: Acquisition historical; carried sample can become lost on actual subsequent failed encounter. A lost/spent case never reappears on retry, entry, amendment, redraw or time.
authority.security: Only actual final Crossing Complete secures carried sample. Secured is a bounded surviving endpoint, NOT observed home return, delivery, sale or NPC receipt.
authority.no_intervention: No HP/resolve/inventory/XP grant or child mutation beyond existing delegated Wait. Missing/wrong-site/stale/malformed/ended requests cannot fabricate paid transitions.

baseline: Unchanged journey without sampling; case alone does not change any actual child action/outcome.

common_preparation: Confirm original Lure/trailborn with draw in slot1
Acquire and craft west+east actual fittings into two Trail rigs before departure
policies.interpretation: These are predeclared original functional routes derived from unchanged rules, not trained agents, independently sampled trials or a balance contest. Exact final outcomes must be executed, not assumed. Failed policies remain evidence.

acceptance: Both named choices reach actual acquisition and final secured custody under actual complete-route policies, with one original case and two actually spent rigs.
Ridge collection occurs before survey ends and remains carried, not secured, after actual survey victory.
Channel collection is a stationary actual pulse response with paid HP loss and beat, not evasion/protection.
Collecting one site permanently excludes the other; no duplicate acquisition/refund/rearm.
Actual later loss changes carried to lost while retaining historical acquisition; retry does not restore case or sample.
Fatal sample pays actual Wait/case but creates no specimen, victory or XP.
Read/reload/redraw/elapsed time preserve exact state and event identity.
Wrong-known-site request refuses without changing child state or sample facts; malformed/forged/stale input cannot supply state.
Body text, source snapshot, actor cargo/seal computed SVG visibility and source action result agree.
Isolated actual false-carried and false-secured renderers are rejected by specific state/picture controls.
Existing affected field/conditions/native/browser/HTTP regressions execute against changed host/UI closure; unchanged child sources retain identities.

measurement.unit: One explicitly scripted actual software journey; controls overlap outcomes and are not people or independent studies.
record: Exact commands, snapshots, response costs and before/after positions/HP/beats
Current source/protocol hashes before and after
Actual captures and bounded host logs
Meaningful failures, refused requests and mutation detection
measurement.claim_boundary: Functional ownership/observation and executable original exploration choice only; no human comprehension, enjoyment, accessibility, fairness, source consumable integration, Unity/Windows/Steam or full field ecology claim.

execution_limits.lifecycle: Stop owned bounded hosts and browser in finally; do not convert wall time into gameplay.

specialist_basis: SCI-013 distinguish ownership/rule benefit from setup and timing rivals
SCI-014 operational outcomes are not player experience
SCI-076 use actual buttons/engine facts for software claims
SCI-077 retain losing/fatal policies, renderer negatives and initial failures
